scenarios.title: Periodic-note navigation and tabbed settings
steps: Open the Chrono workspace and navigate between the seeded daily and weekly notes
Open every settings tab and switch language between Follow Obsidian, English, and Simplified Chinese
Use the daily-note command and approve its preview to create today's note from the seeded template
expected: Calendar selection and periodic-note anchors remain consistent
The imperative tabbed settings surface remains complete and usable
Template creation is previewable and creates only the requested note

scenarios.title: Explicit and unmarked range-note recognition
steps: Open the Range notes settings tab and read the recognition guide and unmarked-note scope
Open the range-note list with the default range-folder scope
Create a range note and inspect its Properties
expected: The guide states that chrono-notes: interval is recognized across the Vault and that unmarked notes use the configured scope
The seeded explicit note outside the range folder and the unmarked note inside it are listed, while the seeded note with chrono-notes: daily is excluded
The new note contains chrono-notes: interval with canonical start and end properties
